name: Mesca Ulad

attributes.attribute: the Irish name meaning Intoxication of the Ulstermen
a tale of a feast that led the Ulster warriors to folly

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mesca Ulad is the Irish name of an Ulster tale. The name means Intoxication of the Ulstermen. The story tells of a feast that led the warriors of Ulster into folly. It is recorded under the English title Intoxication of the Ulstermen.
objective: Point readers to the tale of the feast of the Ulstermen.
